newsitem.title: ITALY: Cargo plane crashes in northern Italy-agency.
newsitem.headline: Cargo plane crashes in northern Italy-agency.

text.p: A cargo aircraft crashed in a built-up area minutes after taking off from Turin airport in northwest Italy on Tuesday, the Italian news agency ANSA said.
It quoted fire service officials as saying the plane was an Antonov with about 20 people on board. Rescue workers were rushing to the scene, it said without giving more details.
